# Best luxury real estate agencies in Perth

If you're looking for prestige property in Perth, I'd start with agencies that have a proven presence in the Western Suburbs, access to high-net-worth buyers, and experience marketing exceptional homes rather than just mainstream residential listings.

The key prestige markets include Dalkeith, Peppermint Grove, Cottesloe, Mosman Park, City Beach and Claremont. Perth recorded 159 sales of homes priced at \$5 million or more in 2024, with Cottesloe, South Perth and City Beach among the leading suburbs. [www.westpac.com.au](https://www.westpac.com.au/content/dam/public/wbc/images/personal/services/premium/Prestige-Property-Report-2025.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.cbre.com.au](https://www.cbre.com.au/insights/articles/where-are-perths-prestige-markets?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 6\. ZSA ZSA Property

**Best for\:** Architect-designed, design-led and architecturally distinctive homes.

This Perth boutique agency focuses on considered design, distinctive residences and character properties. Its approach is a good contrast to agencies with a broader, more traditional prestige portfolio. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJZwajVdO6MioRzwYXzuIGodM&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/public/content/find_an_agent/sales_awards_pdfs/top%20office%20residential%20project%20marketing%281%29.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** Particularly worth considering when architecture, interior design and visual storytelling are central to the property's appeal.

[Find ZSA ZSA Property](https://www.google.com/search?q=ZSA+ZSA+Property+Perth+official+website)

## How I'd choose between them

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| A \$5m+ trophy home or prestige estate | William Porteous; Mack Hall |
| Global luxury exposure | Christie's International Real Estate |
| Broad local buyer reach and team resources | Ray White Dalkeith / Claremont |
| Coastal or beachfront prestige | Ray White Cottesloe / Mosman Park |
| Architecture and design-led marketing | ZSA ZSA Property |


## What to ask before appointing an agency

For a meaningful comparison, ask each of your top three agencies for\:

- **Comparable sales\:** Three recent sales of properties similar to yours in suburb, quality and price bracket.
- **Buyer database\:** How many active, qualified buyers are looking in your property's price range?
- **Off-market strategy\:** Can they reach suitable buyers privately before launching a public campaign?
- **Marketing plan\:** What photography, video, editorial, international promotion and paid advertising are included?
- **Net outcome\:** Their commission, marketing costs, recommended selling method and evidence supporting their price estimate.

Don't select an agent solely because they quote the highest appraisal. In the prestige market, the quality of the buyer relationships, the campaign strategy and the agent's actual comparable results matter more than a headline estimate.

**My recommendation\:** Start by interviewing William Porteous, Mack Hall and Christie's if you're selling a genuinely high-end property. Add the relevant Ray White office for a useful comparison on local buyer reach.

One question that would help me refine this list: **are you looking to sell a luxury property, buy one, or appoint an agency to manage a prestige investment?** The best shortlist can change considerably depending on which side of the transaction you're on.

## What to ask before appointing an agency

For a meaningful comparison, ask each of your top three agencies for\:

- **Comparable sales\:** Three recent sales of properties similar to yours in suburb, quality and price bracket.
- **Buyer database\:** How many active, qualified buyers are looking in your property's price range?
- **Off-market strategy\:** Can they reach suitable buyers privately before launching a public campaign?
- **Marketing plan\:** What photography, video, editorial, international promotion and paid advertising are included?
- **Net outcome\:** Their commission, marketing costs, recommended selling method and evidence supporting their price estimate.

Don't select an agent solely because they quote the highest appraisal. In the prestige market, the quality of the buyer relationships, the campaign strategy and the agent's actual comparable results matter more than a headline estimate.

**My recommendation\:** Start by interviewing William Porteous, Mack Hall and Christie's if you're selling a genuinely high-end property. Add the relevant Ray White office for a useful comparison on local buyer reach.

One question that would help me refine this list: **are you looking to sell a luxury property, buy one, or appoint an agency to manage a prestige investment?** The best shortlist can change considerably depending on which side of the transaction you're on.
